create_logger: create a logger with file and console handlers using create_logger function with filepath and rank arguments
create_log_formatter: create a LogFormatter instance that formats log records with elapsed time since initialization
reset_logger_time: reset the elapsed time tracking of a logger created by create_logger using the reset_time method
format_log_record: format a log record with LogFormatter to include levelname, timestamp, and elapsed duration
create_logger_per_process: create separate log files for each process by passing a rank greater than zero to create_logger
